prompts.document: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photographic supporting scene for an AI literacy video for high school students. Candid editorial realism, natural proportions, soft natural window light, ordinary clothing, believable setting, restrained warm colors. No cartoon, no illustration look, no fantasy machinery, no logos, no watermark. No legible text; exact teaching labels will be composited separately. Wide landscape 16:9 composition. A thoughtful 17-year-old student in a plain olive shirt sits at a bright library table, comparing an open thick printed basketball rulebook on the table with a laptop beside it. The student visibly follows a line in the printed book with a finger and looks between book and screen. Over-the-shoulder three-quarter view, show the student on the left half, open book and laptop in the lower middle; realistic hands and visible act of checking. Laptop screen has only indistinct grey text lines on white. Printed book similarly has subtle unreadable lines. A basketball rests unobtrusively on the floor at the far left. Leave the rightmost quarter quiet and softly out of focus; the video will place readable excerpt cards alongside the photograph. Avoid any giant floating text or UI panels.
